insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified in extract (Base Sum Insured + Booster+ SI + Safeguard/Safeguard+ SI + ReAssure+/ReAssureX as per Policy Schedule/variant)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: You can choose any room without a daily limit, but higher room costs will use up your Sum Insured faster.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: Extra Sum Insured is added after your base limit is used, and it can be triggered repeatedly for lifetime coverage if the policy is renewed continuously.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: “Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured... (this 10 Lakh will trigger unlimited times)”
great.explanation: After your first claim, additional Sum Insured is restored unlimited times for future claims, enhancing your coverage.

great.name: PED Waiting Period
great.quote: “Pre-existing Diseases... shall be excluded until the expiry of 12months/24 months/ 36 months (as per Variant selected) of continuous coverage”
great.explanation: If you select the 12-month option, pre-existing diseases are covered after just one year, which is better than the usual longer waits.

great.name: Specific Illness Waiting
great.quote: “Specified disease/procedure... excluded until the expiry of 24 months/12 months (as per Variant Selected)”
great.reference: Section 5.1.2 Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02)
great.explanation: Choosing the 12-month variant means coverage for specified diseases starts sooner than the standard 24 months.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident”
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days, but accidents are covered immediately from day one.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “We will pay expenses... for 60 days before the date of admission”
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses related to your hospitalization are covered for up to 60 days before admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.reference: Section 4.1.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses related to your hospitalization are covered for up to 180 days after discharge.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home... would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home...”
good.explanation: Treatment at home is covered when medically necessary and monitored, providing flexibility if hospital admission is not possible.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. We will pay up to Base Sum Insured.”
good.reference: Section 4.1.1(a)-(b) Expenses in reaching a Hospital
good.explanation: Emergency air ambulance transport is covered up to your base Sum Insured, ensuring quick access to hospital care.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments, up to Base Sum Insured for the list as specified below...”
good.explanation: Certain modern treatments are covered up to your base Sum Insured but limited to a specified list.

good.name: Optional Worldwide Cover
good.quote: “Borderless... Choose from a range of co-payments options 0%, 20%, 30%, 40% & 50%”
good.explanation: You can opt for worldwide treatment coverage with a co-pay percentage that you select.

good.name: Optional Claim Safeguard
good.quote: “Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’.”
good.reference: Section 4.1.20.1.1 Claim Safeguard and Annexure I
good.explanation: An optional benefit that covers some normally excluded expenses and offers inflation-linked Sum Insured increases.

good.name: Optional Add-ons
good.quote: “Optional Benefit: 4.1.14. Annual Aggregate Deductible” / “4.1.16. Co-Payment” / “4.1.18. Room Type Modification” / “4.1.25. WellConsult (OPD): Opt for complete wellness and OPD benefits.”
good.explanation: You can customize your policy with optional deductible, co-pay, room type changes, and outpatient wellness benefits.

bad.name: No NCB
bad.quote: Not mentioned in the provided policy wording extract.
bad.explanation: No No Claim Bonus or renewal Sum Insured growth is stated, so you may not get extra benefits for claim-free renewals.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “The expenses that are not covered... Annexure I - The expenses that are not covered...”
bad.reference: Section 6.2.4(c) and Annexure I; plus Safeguard description in 4.1.20/4.1.21
bad.explanation: Many consumables and non-payable items are excluded by default and only covered if you buy an optional safeguard benefit.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear for every claim, Rest we will pay.”
bad.explanation: Co-pay exists but the default percentage is not clearly stated; it depends on your chosen option or policy schedule.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: “Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY... for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.”
unclear.explanation: A cashless hospital network is available but the exact number of hospitals is not specified in the document.

unclear.name: Restore Variant
unclear.quote: “Either ReAssure+ or ReAssureX can be offered in a single policy.”
unclear.explanation: Two restore benefit variants exist but only one applies per policy; check your schedule to know which one you have.

unclear.name: Room Type Modification
unclear.quote: “Room Type Modification... You can choose between a Standard Single Room and a Shared Room up to Sum Insured... You will have to bear additional co-payment IF treatment is taken in a higher room category than the eligible room category”
unclear.explanation: If you opt for room type modification, your room entitlement and co-pay change; confirm if this applies to your policy.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
